info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Labor API

params.name: tasks
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Tasks. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of task IDs.

params.name: users
params.description: This parameter is used to only get labor records for a specific user or set of users in a comma delimited list.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get labor that was logged after the unix timestamp passed into the start parameter. For example, all Assets that were last edited after April 18th, 2018.

params.name: end
params.description: This parameter is used to only get labor that was logged *before* the unix timestamp passed into the end parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what taskID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 137 here will only get you tasks with an id greater than 137.

params.name: locations
params.description: This parameter is used to retrieve labor entries for particular locations. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of location IDs.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: This parameter is used to order results by their dateLogged property instead of the default ordering. CANNOT be provided alongside the cursor parameter. to paginate in this ordering, use the start or end parameters.

items.docs:
This request gets the labor (time spent) on a Task. A single Task can have multiple times logged onto it.

Return data description

meta | This property contains shortcuts to other requests that can be used to get more information regarding the Task the labor was logged on and the user who logged the time.
taskID | The Task ID associated with this labor entry.
timeSpent | The amount of time measure in seconds.
userWage | The wage per hour.
description | A description of the labor entry.
dateLogg

This request gets the labor categories.

Return data description

Property: categoryID, Description: The unique ID for this billing category.
Property: categoryName, Description: The name of this billing category.
Property: categoryRate, Description: The rate per hour of this billing category.
